answer: We prove Sybil resistance by binding agent identities to a recursive zero-knowledge trellis of sequential proof state transitions. In this model, nodes post staking collateral that is slashed if a verifiable delay function exposes duplicate queries across the consensus knoll. Because identity cloning requires generating sequential proofs that outpace the baseline timber of verifiable computation, the negative expected utility of an attack enforces a robust Nash equilibrium where honest participation remains the dominant strategy.
